=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:180-207 | severity=critical | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: extract_identity_recall_metadata() does not skip the <compaction-rules> block, so compaction-prefixed legacy prompts fail the Role/Goal parse and identity-recall injection is omitted.
  WHY: With UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true, the regex never matches the opening paragraph and the script emits IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL for the affected prompts, breaking identity-recall rendering.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:117-145 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: resolve_identity_source_prompt() redirects prompts/mode-*.txt to prompts/_templates/mode-*.txt under PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=true without a compatible identity-metadata parsing path for the shared compaction-prefixed body.
  WHY: Reviewers reported this silently changes the canonical-source contract for legacy prompts and still leaves the refactored path failing the same identity-recall metadata parse.
- tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh:71-84 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: _opening_role_goal_shape() mirrors the old skip logic and does not ignore <compaction-rules> blocks or Jinja prelude lines, so it misclassifies compaction-prefixed prompts.
  WHY: The corpus check no longer validates identity recall for the affected mode prompts and can pass or assert against the wrong paragraph shape.
- scripts/render_prompt.sh:244-267 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The identity-recall temp-file lifecycle can leave .mode-*.identity.* files behind when the injection path fails.
  WHY: Reviewers reported repeated failures can accumulate leaked /tmp files because cleanup is only tied to the identity-reinject flow.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

=== CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
- requirement: "Verify implementation: UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true bash scripts/render_prompt.sh prompts/mode-plan.txt runs successfully (no IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL exit) and the rendered output contains the <identity-recall> block."
  expected_change_site: scripts/render_prompt.sh — extract_identity_recall_metadata()
  confidence=5
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The current skip logic only excludes blank lines, # comments, and Jinja {%...%} directives; it does not skip <compaction-rules>, and reviewers reproduced IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL on compaction-prefixed prompts.
- requirement: "`tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh`'s `_opening_role_goal_shape()` helper must mirror the renderer's skip rules for `<compaction-rules>` and Jinja prelude lines so the identity-recall corpus check validates compaction-prefixed prompts correctly."
  expected_change_site: tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh — _opening_role_goal_shape()
  confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, mistralai_mistral-small-2603, moonshotai_kimi-k2_5, qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  EVIDENCE: The helper only skips blank lines and # comments; it does not skip <compaction-rules> blocks or {%...%} directives.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===

=== FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: extract_identity_recall_metadata() function, Python heredoc lines 194-207
  Problem: The metadata-extraction skip block checks for blank lines, # comment lines, and {%...%} Jinja directives, but does not skip <compaction-rules>...</compaction-rules> XML blocks.
  Why it fails at runtime: When UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true, render_prompt.sh calls extract_identity_recall_metadata, which exits 1 for the 28 compaction-prefixed prompts and omits the <identity-recall> block from the rendered prompt.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
=== END FINDINGS FROM deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro ===

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: extract_identity_recall_metadata() function (the Python heredoc, around line 194-207)
  Problem: The metadata extraction function only skips blank lines, lines starting with #, and Jinja {%...%} directives, but does NOT skip the <compaction-rules> block that now appears at the start of 28 legacy mode prompt files.
  Why it fails at runtime: When UNATTENDED_IDENTITY_REINJECT_ENABLED=true and PROMPT_PRELUDE_REFACTOR_ENABLED=false, bash scripts/render_prompt.sh prompts/mode-plan.txt emits IDENTITY_REINJECT_PARSE_FAIL: mode-plan reason=metadata_extract_failed and silently skips identity-recall injection for that phase.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- File: tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh
  Line or code reference: _opening_role_goal_shape() function (around line 76)
  Problem: The test's _opening_role_goal_shape() helper only skips blank lines and lines starting with #, but does NOT skip the <compaction-rules> block or Jinja {%...%} directives.
  Why it fails at runtime: When legacy prompts begin with the shared-prelude compaction block, the helper consumes those lines instead of the Role: ... Goal: ... line and misclassifies valid prompts as not identity-eligible.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: cleanup_temp_files function / trap
  Problem: The cleanup trap only runs when the identity-reinject path executes, but temp files can be created even when metadata extraction fails and the function exits early.
  Why it fails at runtime: Repeated failures can accumulate /tmp/.mode-*.identity.* files in long-running orchestrator-poll runners.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 3
- File: scripts/render_prompt.sh
  Line or code reference: extract_identity_recall_metadata() function, lines 194-207
  Problem: The function was modified to add Jinja skip logic, but the fundamental extraction behavior change (new block at start of prompts) wasn't fully addressed.
  Why it fails at runtime: Identity-recall block is silently omitted for many phases, causing inconsistent judge/consolidator memory records and breaking the ledger continuity required by §16 Output Contract.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Every active legacy prompts/mode-*.txt snapshot should match the assembled _templates output exactly so the shared-prelude path remains byte-stable and flag-gated" (from the linked issue, Expected behavior section)
  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.sh - the extract_identity_recall_metadata() function needs to skip <compaction-rules>...</compaction-rules> XML blocks before parsing Role/Goal
  Evidence of absence: The current code at line 198 only skips: if not line or line.startswith("#") or (line.startswith("{%") and line.endswith("%}")):. There is no skip for lines containing <compaction-rules> or similar XML tags.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- Requirement: "Treat the assembled template output as the source of truth and sync the 28 affected legacy mode prompt files to that output."
  Expected change site: prompts/mode-*.txt + tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh
  Evidence of absence: The prompt files ARE correctly synchronized (verified by reading prompts/mode-plan.txt - it has the compaction-rules block). However, the test helper _opening_role_goal_shape() doesn't skip <compaction-rules>, causing it to misclassify these prompts.
  SEVERITY: MAJOR
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m2_5 ===

  Why it fails at runtime: The corpus check can mis-shape or skip assertions for compaction-prefixed legacy prompts, making the validation of identity-recall output no longer reliable.
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4

  Line or code reference: cleanup_temp_files() trap, lines 359-366
  Problem: The trap only sets IDENTITY_RECALL_INJECTED_FILE and registers cleanup when the identity-reinject path runs.
  Why it fails at runtime: Temp file accumulation under /tmp in long-running orchestrator-poll runners.

  Expected change site: scripts/render_prompt.sh + tests/test_identity_recall_render.sh
